lights.title: Ambient light
lights.note: Drag it by the header to get it out of the way; the X closes it without deleting the light. The light really lights: it is clipped by walls and does not spill to the other side. The kind sets the flicker rhythm — a torch trembles, a bonfire breathes, a bulb snaps.

roll.noStats: The manual publishes no characteristics for this creature, so there is nothing to roll.
roll.failed: The roll could not be made. Try again.
roll.attacksNote: The book prints these attacks already worked out, weapon and damage (p.{{page}}). They are copied, not recomputed.
roll.blastNote: The Blast is an attack apart from the main one: it is rolled on its own, against whoever stands close (p.108).
roll.blastNoStat: A Blast is not rolled with any characteristic: the dice come from its own score.
roll.metresFrom: radius {{radius}} m · one die less per metre
roll.blastDamage: Each success deals 1 point of damage and each triumph as many as the score: {{n}}. Beyond the radius there is no attack.
roll.blastDifficulty: A Blast is always a difficulty 1 challenge (p.108): the director may raise it when allowing cover, as with shooting (p.96).
roll.capabilitiesNote: Only the ones matching the characteristic and the hour show up: by day none of the night ones appear. The director marks them, like the specialty — the engine cannot know whether the roll is meant to intimidate (p.107).
